purpose: Fix canonical hashing, raw-file identity, package folds, genesis, and derivation order.
rules: Use RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8, uint64be framing, SHA-256, and domain-separated tags.
Keep semantic hashes distinct from raw-file SHA-256.
Candidate inventories have no exclusions; evaluator payload excludes only package.manifest.json.
Parent-staged genesis has revision zero and empty event and outbox ledgers.
Seal an output before its immutable derivation sidecar; prohibit self and mutual references.
